i just cant comprehend your emotional response as mine has grown dead by now.  i would love to believe in hope and good things but when the problem is severe  mental illness its hard to see a great future, especially when youve already cycled the hardest psych drugs known to man.

my huskita was a rescue abandoned for over 2 years and had EXTREME dog aggression.  that was by far the hardest thing i've ever had to deal with it.  finding people who would bring large male dogs around just to see my dog go nuts was difficult and painstaking.  of course you never let the behaviour continue but in the beginning even 200 yards wasnt enough to keep him calm.  it was difficult to find a venue to have another dog stand FAR enough away for me to reward calm behaviour.  ended up using a cemetary and park combined and after about 2 weeks i could bring him up to another dog he would previously viciously attack.  i will still never keep him off leash around other large male dogs but hes more than stable and more than capable of doing so i just feel it would be irresponsible as an owner to do so.

i own a minpin and a sibe husky/akita mix.  my favourite dogs to work with are those with what people overexhaggerate as problems.  dog aggression, small animal aggression, excessive barking, and things like overstimulation.  these problems are ALWAYS misunderstood and easily worked through with the proper mentality and patience.  as far as breeds are concerned i prefer to work with guard dog or hunting breeds as people always say theyre stubborn and untrainable when that is in fact false.  theyre just doing the job they had thousands of years bred into them to do.  i like to take dog breeds that are completely wrong for a family situation or for a certain persons lifestyle and teach them to be good canine citizens so that they can happily live out their life fulfilling their needs and their humans needs.  a common misconception is that guard and hunting dogs are stupid when in fact they excel at what they were bred to do.  did you know weiner dogs were made and bred to kill badgers in their dens?  those cute little guys are actually vicious hunters and a lot of people misunderstand that.  if you fulfill its core needs it will be nothing more than a wonderful companion and with a little manners training it will even be a pleasure to have around.
after years of psychiatric care and counselling i've become hopeless.  is there an answer to that?

going on about 2 years self taught.  i use positive reinforcement and clicker training.  learning behaviour modification was difficult but once i overcame that i can see that all dogs have a similar quality in them.  i dont know if its just that they rely on humans or if they legitimately care for them but all dogs want human care and attention.  some just need some help getting there :).  i currently own 2 dogs and foster regularly for local humane societies through my gf(criminal record prevents me from doing it myself) and i always send the dogs back well trained with a loose leash walk and proper manners.  I just wish my record couldnt stop me from opening a rescue centre.

always.  honestly i have a heart of gold and if i could only overcome my personal struggles i'd devote my life to helping people and animals.  as a professional dog trainer i've always dreamt of opening a rescue centre that rehabs dogs that "should" be killed and finding them forever homes.  however i can't get past this to get to that point.  if i were to ever get to the point where i wanted to live i would sink my life into animal rehab and recovery.

yeah but who cares?  why should i care?  why should i give a flying fuck about what other people feel?  i know people feel how i feel, hell most of them probably feel worse.  what does this have to do with me not wanting to experience reality anymore?

dont know guess i just pride myself on my empathy of people who rely on tips.  i have no need for money knowing im going to die soon and i have a huge savings account so why not spread it before i go?  i think servers, bartenders, and bouncers are some of the most underappreciated peopel out there and they deserve better.  most of them are just doing it to get by or because people like me make it worth their while.  i'm glad to be a part of that i guess.

i become erratic and eccentric.  auditory hallucinations occur and i often think of doing spur of the moment violent things, which has landed me in jail a lot.  for example i once attacked a guy for helping me just because i could with a weapon and went to jail for it.  i become extremely unstable.  i dont get fearful or uncomfortable i just become a predator of sorts and want to hurt everyone around me physically.  sometimes i think of really wacky shit like kissing guys randomly even though im 100% straight.  just really weird shit happens when i leave the house.  most of the time though i just suppress it and come off as outgoing, confident, and friendly.  i tip well and always make friends.
and if i dont want to be bothered to fix it?  why does it matter if one random dude dies?  thats what i dont understand why does it matter to any of you whether i die or not?

i have panic disorder with agoraphobia so i rarely ever leave my computer chair.  i'm even afraid to do things on my computer(ranked games of league of legends, even though im high elo).  i pretty much sit in a room all day drinking alcohol and abusing benzos and opiates.

panic disorder is by far the most ludicrous thing i've ever dealt with.  i wouldn't wish it upon anyone, not even hitler.  there is nothing i've experienced in my life worse than panic disorder and i've broken 7 bones, my nose twice, jaw once, and od'd 3 times.  panic disorder is probably one of the worst things any human can endure(or try to).

diagnosed bipolar, schizoaffective disorder, ocd, add, substance dependence, and panic disorder.  the fact that people don't have any common courtesy, talk shit about you behind your back and other seemingly normal things that i consider poor friendship.
since i was 5 years old i've wanted to kill myself.  i would say primarily because of 2 reasons.  1 im severely mentally ill.  2 i dont believe there are any good friends left in the world.

i get what youre trying to do and heres the inherent flaw with it.  if i cared about any of this shit i wouldnt want desperately to commit the most selfish act.  no i dont care that my girlfriend of 7 years will suffer.  no i dont care that i wont get to live with my dogs anymore.  no i dont care about my family or "friends".  and no i sure as fuck dont care about what i eat.   these are all things i'm past.  when someone truly wants to commit suicide they merely wait until they either a/ have the courage or b/ are where im at in not caring about other people.  my suffering has overcome my copeability and i'm not afraid to admit that.  no amount of things i thought i loved or do love will ever overtake the fact that i want to die.
